turns.user: how much pto do i have in 2026 and does it carry over?
turns.agent:
Your 2026 PTO accrual depends on your length of service:

- Less than 2 years: 18 days per year
- 2 to under 5 years: 22 days per year
- 5 years or more: 25 days per year

PTO accrues each semi-monthly pay period, and the rate changes in the pay period containing your service anniversary. Part-time employees accrue proportionally. For a full-time employee, one day equals 8 hours.

You can carry over up to 10 days (80 hours) of unused PTO from 2025 into 2026. Those carried-over hours must be used by June 30, 2026; any PTO above the limit is generally forfeited on December 31, subject to state law. Sick leave and floating holidays do not carry over.

people-announcement-2025-11-pto-carryover (Announcement: PTO Carryover Limit Raised; posted 2025-11-17)
1: # Announcement: PTO Carryover Limit Raised
3: Posted: 2025-11-17
4: From: Tessa Nguyen, Director of People Operations
5: To: All US employees
7: Many of you told us in the October survey that the end of the year is a hard time to use up vacation days, because customer go-lives and the winter closure fall in the same weeks. We have changed the carryover rule in response.
9: ## What is changing
11: Starting with the rollover from 2025 into 2026, you may carry over up to 10 days (80 hours) of unused PTO into the next calendar year. Carried-over PTO must be used by June 30 of that year.
13: This replaces Section 5 of the Paid Time Off Policy (HR-101, effective 2025-01-01), which allowed 5 days and set a deadline of March 31. The same section of the Employee Handbook is replaced as well. The policy document will be reissued at its next annual review. Until then, this announcement is the rule.
15: ## What is not changing
17: - Accrual rates stay the same.
18: - PTO above the carryover limit is still forfeited on December 31, except where state law does not permit forfeiture.
19: - Sick leave and floating holidays still do not carry over.
20: - The Netherlands addendum is not affected.
22: ## What you need to do
24: Nothing. PeopleHub will apply the new limit automatically on December 31, 2025. You can see your projected year-end balance under Time Off, Balances.
26: Questions go to Imani Brooks or to people@cardinal-energy.example.
